proof.criterion: Concurrency addition: reviews posted while a run waits leave at most one pending run per pull request and event, and the newest run's pr-title stands on the head
proof.surface: GitHub Actions on sjawhar/legion, scratch PR sjawhar/legion#2255 (head 88e0dffe), driven with gh api
proof.command: two COMMENT reviews 1 s apart: gh api --method POST repos/sjawhar/legion/pulls/2255/reviews -f event=COMMENT (x2)
proof.observed: Reviews 5654004610 and 5654004947 -> runs 40343824683 (cancelled) and 40343828930 (success); every earlier pull_request_review run was cancelled by the next, while the queued pull_request run 40343578035 was not touched by review runs (cancelled only by the next pull_request run). gh pr checks shows one pr-title per event, both pass; rollup SUCCESS
proof.negativeControl: Single group pr-title-<number> for all events (head ebf883ee, scratch #2250 at 672e3e1a): review runs cancelled pull_request run 40329132323, so gh pr checks listed 'pr-title fail' (pull_request) beside 'pr-title pass' (review run 40330236878) and the commit's statusCheckRollup state stayed FAILURE after every required check passed

trickyParts: GitHub lists a pull request's checks once per check name and event: a single concurrency group across events lets a review run cancel a pull_request run, leaving that event's latest pr-title cancelled and the commit rollup FAILURE (scratch #2250). The group is therefore pr-title-<event>-<number>.
An inline comment posted alone also fires pull_request_review submitted, so it still starts exactly one PR Title run; the header never says an inline comment starts no run.
deviations: The architect's concurrency addition asked for group pr-title-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}; the head uses pr-title-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} for the per-event check listing above (reported to the architect with evidence). At most one running and one pending run per event, so at most four per pull request.
ce-simplify-code applied one change: as_event became as_review_event (no argument).
